description: Weak supervision (Snorkel-style programmatic labeling): read or replace a project's sandboxed labeling functions, or run them — preview returns coverage/overlap/conflict/gold-accuracy metrics; apply writes majority-vote winners as pre-label PREDICTIONS (never annotations; gold and completed rows are excluded). Pass cursor from a prior run's nextCursor to continue past the per-run row cap. Requires open-label:read for get, open-label:write for save/run, plus the project capability matrix.

cursor.description: run: continue from a prior run's nextCursor.

expectedFingerprint.description: run: pin later batches to the first batch's configFingerprint.

functions.description: save: the full replacement function list.

name: open_label_weak_supervision
